{{Quote|I think we should avoid that cave, sir. Unnecessary elimination of native predatory species is discouraged by the Unaligned Worlds Protocol Handbook.|Elara Dorne|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Unaligned Worlds Protocol Handbook''' was a book of regulations and protocol used by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. It discouraged [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from the unnecessary elimination of native predators.
